component.name: Redragon Control
component.summary: Lighting and key remapping for Redragon K686 MAX keyboards

description.p: Control your Redragon K686 MAX keyboard with native desktop settings, lighting effects, profiles and reversible key remapping.

Includes a one-time hardware setup helper and automatic startup after sign-in. Requires a Linux desktop with background portal support and udev device permissions. Independent software, not affiliated with Redragon.
Fix the Flatpak tray icon appearing as three dots by using the exported app icon and a host-visible icon lookup path.
